Enabled.Name: Show the second row
Enabled.Hint: Adds a second hotbar row beside the first. Off until you turn it on; each user decides for themselves.

Slots.Name: Second row: slots shown
Slots.Hint: How many slots the second hotbar row shows, from 1 to 10. Kept for this browser.

LiftChat.Name: Lift panels at the bottom right
LiftChat.Hint: When the second row reaches under the right-hand column (Foundry's floating chat input, PF2e HUD's combat tracker and the like), move that column up so both can be used. When off, the second row shrinks to stop before those panels instead, and the chat input may cover it.

Accent.Name: Second row: accent color
Accent.Hint: Colors the second row's slot borders, number badges and page selector, and tints its empty slots, so it stands apart from the first row. Each user picks their own.

AccentCustom.Name: Second row: custom accent color
AccentCustom.Hint: Used when the accent color is set to Custom.

AccentStrength.Name: Second row: accent strength
AccentStrength.Hint: How strong the accent is on the slots (the tint behind empty slots and the slot borders), in percent. The number badges are always solid.

Editor.Title: Hotbar: {name}
Editor.Help: Drop macros, roll tables, items or other documents on a slot; drag to move or swap. Click a macro to edit it, or an empty slot to make a new one. Right-click for more; Shift+right-click deletes the macro.
Editor.Shared: {macro} is now shared with {name} (Observer), so they can see and run it.
Editor.GMOnly: Only a GM can edit other users' hotbars.
Editor.Unsupported: That can't be put on another user's hotbar yet (a PF2e action or strike, say). Drop the item or a macro instead.
Editor.TargetHidden: {name} can't open {document}, so this macro won't work for them until you share it.
